systems.country_label: Learner Unit Record Information and Tracking System (LURITS)
systems.tiers: national; receives uploaded databases covering ordinary public and independent schools

note: No fact: the document is a statistical leaflet that says only that its 2025 figures come from databases uploaded on LURITS and Provincial Data Warehouses as at July 2025, with about 99.9% of functional ordinary schools (24,766 schools) uploaded; it does not say what schools enter, per learner or otherwise, or how often, so the system is unclassified.
